# Pinned official IFEval input and evaluator

Source: Google Research, instruction_following_eval, Apache License 2.0.
Original repository: https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/instruction_following_eval

These files are copied unchanged from the frozen evaluator/input already
shipped in our language Pareto handoff. The campaign pins the exact SHA256
of input_data.jsonl and evaluation_lib.py before scoring. Do not reformat
or update the vendor code inside an existing campaign.

input_data.jsonl contains the complete 541-prompt IFEval dataset. This
copy retains the original copyright and license headers; see LICENSE.
